notes.title: Beta 3 Now Available
notes.content:
[h1]Pizza Crafting[/h1]
Collect pizza toppings, from pepperoni to anchovy, to add to your pizza blaster. Each topping adds a unique modifier to your attack--from fiery pepper blasts to bouncy escargot slices. Pair up to six toppings on a pizza pie to build the ultimate attack.

[h1]Teleportation[/h1]
Enlist the help of a god-like race of aliens to build up your Cosmic power. Use this newfound power to unlock new abilities like teleportation and healing. You're definitely gonna need it...
